name: ibis Styles Bangkok Silom
short_description: A 264-room design-economy hotel on Silom Road with a 4.6/5 ALL Rating (3,265 reviews), a rooftop bar, pool bar, and easy BTS/MRT access.
ai_summary: ibis Styles Bangkok Silom sits on Silom Road at the heart of the Bangkok CBD, with easy access to BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Silom. The 264-room property holds a strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from 3,265 reviews — a substantial review base. Rooms feature a 43-inch Smart LCD TV, high-speed Wi-Fi, and rain showers, with connecting rooms available for families. Facilities include a restaurant, lobby bar and cafe, rooftop bar, pool bar, fitness centre, and a ballroom or 3 separate meeting rooms. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: 289 Silom Road, Silom, Bangrak District, 10500 Bangkok, Thailand
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: 264 rooms with a very strong 4.6/5 ALL Rating from a large base of 3,265 reviews
Central Silom CBD location with easy access to both BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Silom
Rooftop bar, pool bar, fitness centre, and flexible meeting facilities for a design-economy price point
cons: Silom's CBD setting is business-oriented — less resort-like atmosphere than Bangkok's riverside or Sukhumvit lifestyle hotels
research_highlights: Rooftop bar, pool bar, fitness centre; BTS Sala Daeng and MRT Silom access
